name: See It First - proof before payment

sequence.note: One of four campaigns built in parallel on 2026-09-05 under plans/four-campaign-flood/plan.md. It is not a narrative sequel to any of them, so series_id in posting-schedule.json is null. Where the other three argue that the reader needs a website, this one answers the objection that stops the sale after they already agree: 'I have been burned before.'

business_goal: Convert business owners who already accept that they need a website but do not trust anyone to build it, by arguing the one differentiator that is real and registry-backed: FAMtastic produces design directions the customer reviews before paying.

angle.objection: I have been burned before. I paid, I waited, and what came back was not what I pictured.
angle.answer: The order of operations. Three directions are generated from the customer's real business information, a person reviews them before the customer sees them, and the customer looks at the work in a private view-only link before money moves.
angle.what_this_campaign_never_claims: That many customers have already been through it. The mechanism is deployed; volume is not evidence we have. No testimonials, customer counts, satisfaction figures, case studies, or delivery-time promises appear anywhere in this campaign.

primary_offer.domain_renewal: separate, at the domain's own cost
primary_offer.scope: One focused landing-page website, one year of FAMtastic-managed hosting, and first-year domain registration or connection of a customer-owned domain. Business email (FAM-BUSINESS-EMAIL, $99) and maintenance (FAM-MAINTENANCE, $49.99/mo) are NOT included.

audiences.label: Owners who already agree they need a website and still will not buy one
audiences.pain: Paid a builder or a freelancer once, waited, and got back something they did not recognise as their business

audiences.label: Owners who have been pitched rankings, traffic, or growth guarantees
audiences.pain: Cannot tell a real capability from a confident sales claim, so they treat every studio as the same risk

audiences.label: Owners who bought a package and discovered the boundaries afterwards
audiences.pain: Found out what was not included only when they needed it
